projection.projection_goal: Provide the evaluation-expert-consumer skill with a workflow contract for evaluating e-commerce customer-service employees, covering red-line gating, dimension scoring, ticket-creation expectations, and closing confirmation.

source_slice.slice_topic: e-commerce customer-service evaluation pipeline with red-line gating and evidence-driven scoring

concept_mappings.notes: Expose the structured test case (expected_behavior_sequence, expected_output, mandatory tool calls) as a first-class workflow input.
Make the captured execution trace (turns, tool_calls, assistant_messages, thoughts) an explicit workflow input so scoring decisions are grounded in evidence.
Bind the employee template id (e.g., customer-service-ecommerce) so dimension weights and red-line thresholds resolve deterministically.
First step: evaluate red-line conditions before any positive scoring; failing this step short-circuits the pipeline to a fail-out result.
Second step: compute the five dimension scores (functional_completeness, interaction_quality, process_compliance, problem_resolution, tool_call_correctness) from the execution trace and test case.
Third step: weighted aggregation (0.25 / 0.20 / 0.20 / 0.15 / 0.20) and per-dimension >=60 plus overall >=70 pass criteria.
Fourth step: assemble the structured report with dimension breakdowns, evidence citations, critical issues, and improvement suggestions.
Final deliverable matching the evaluator SKILL output schema (overall_score, passed, red_lines_triggered, dimension_scores, critical_issues, improvement_points, recommendation).

relation_mappings.notes: Red-line evaluation must complete before per-dimension scoring runs; if any red line triggers, the pipeline must short-circuit instead of computing weighted scores.
Aggregation must consume completed per-dimension scores; partial scores must not be aggregated.
Report build must consume the final overall score and pass/fail decision; reports must not be drafted from interim scoring buffers.
tool_call_correctness scoring must read tool_call records from executionTrace; missing required tool calls must be flagged as critical evidence.

constraint_mappings.notes: If executionTrace lacks any tool call marked mandatory in the test case (e.g., create_ticket for return scenarios), set tool_call_correctness = 0 and short-circuit to fail-out before aggregation.
If process_compliance score <= 30 (severe procedural violation), short-circuit to fail-out regardless of other dimension scores.
If interaction_quality score <= 30 (cold/mechanical tone, dismissive replies), short-circuit to fail-out regardless of other dimension scores.
If functional_completeness score <= 40 (core task unresolved), short-circuit to fail-out regardless of other dimension scores.
Mark passed = true only when overall_score >= 70 AND every dimension score >= 60 AND no red line triggered. Any single-dimension dip below 60 must result in passed = false.
Every dimension score adjustment (positive or negative) must carry an evidence reference quoting the conversation or tool-call record. Adjustments without evidence must be rejected and re-derived.

forbidden_assumptions: Do not invent dimension names that are not declared in the customer-service-ecommerce metric set.
Do not bypass red-line short-circuit by averaging it away in weighted aggregation.
Do not produce passed = true when any red line triggered, even if overall_score >= 70.
Do not add new mandatory tool calls that are not declared in the test case.
reasoning_paths: load_test_case -> load_execution_trace -> red_line_check -> score_dimensions -> aggregate_overall_score -> build_evaluation_report
